blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division denied separate bail petitions of Senator Rodante Marcoleta and his co-accused former lawmaker Mike Defensor and two businessmen. This was over their P75-million plunder case, which stemmed from a campaign donation. This also means that Marcoleta, and his 3 co-accused will remain detained at the Quezon City Jail […]...
